review:
Eye of the Panda is set in an underground club run by a chef-turned-bouncer panda. It's a 5x5 game with 27 paylines, Hoppers and Super Cascades.

Super Cascades trigger after every win: all symbols in winning lines, plus every other instance of the winning symbols on screen, are removed before new symbols fall in, and this continues until no new wins form. Wild Panda multipliers carry 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x or 10x and substitute for all regular symbols; if more than one shares a line, their values multiply together rather than add. Two bonus rounds are available. Hacksaw rates it 3 out of 5 with a 10,000x maximum and a top RTP of 96.26%.
